followup_explanation: This is a benign, friendly math question with no harm-adjacent content, so the aversion/preference dimensions don't favor either model. That makes it a pure capability call. Plover-235B has stronger scores across the relevant general-reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 55.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 82.7), which all point to better quantitative reasoning. Since the task is essentially a math/reasoning problem, I routed to the model with the clearer capability edge there.
